children: may test a support at $4,241 per ounce, a break below which could open the way toward $4,133.
A retracement analysis on the uptrend from $3,959 reveals a break below the 50% level of $4,328. The break confirmed an extension of the downtrend to the 61.8% level of $4,241.
A projection analysis on the fall from $4,630 marks a similar target range of $4,144-$4,176, formed by the 361.8% and the 338.2% levels.

The resistance zone is from $4,310 to $4,330, a break above which may lead to a gain to $4,361-$4,393 range. On the daily chart, a retracement analysis on the fall from $4,889 points to a target of $4,168, the 23.6% level, as the metal has more or less broken the 38.2% level of $4,306.
Given that the bounce from $3,943 failed to extend above a key resistance at $4,763, the 50% retracement of the downtrend from $5,595, the current fall looks like a continuation of the trend.
